repos_data.description: Cloud architecture diagrams in both directions: AI prompt or JSON to diagram, diagram to Terraform via MCP server, and Terraform to diagram...
MCP server for Diagrams.so. 23 tools that let an AI agent generate, edit and review cloud architecture diagrams as native draw.io files.

repo_meta_data.description: Understand any codebase in 60 seconds - an MCP server, CLI and GitHub Action that turns any repo into an architecture diagram (Mermaid/Graphviz) and enforces architecture rules in CI. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP client.
